fix_subject: Fix spurious checksum failures from stale block handles racing in-place metadata rewrites

labels.summary: Stale block handles replaced by ConvertToTransient could reread a disk metadata block being rewritten in place, causing spurious checksum failures and a false 'Corrupt database' error; replaced handles now refuse disk loads, Pin retries with the current handle, and destroying a stale handle no longer unregisters a newer live handle's block id.

failing: cpp:test/api/test_metadata_pin_race.cpp::A dying stale block handle does not unregister a newer handle
cpp:test/api/test_metadata_pin_race.cpp::Pinning a replaced metadata block handle does not read from disk
